name: SIQ - Reveal Carousel
description: Cinematic image carousel with dramatic curtain-reveal transitions. Each slide features a wipe/clip animation that reveals images with stunning visual impact. Includes filmstrip thumbnail navigation, parallax hover effect, autoplay with progress indicator, slide counter, and rich editorial captions with badge/eyebrow/heading/subtitle/CTA. Choose from 4 transition styles: curtain, zoom, blur, and slide. Full color/typography/layout customization with 80+ options. Perfect for luxury brands, fashion editorials, real estate showcases, and portfolio highlights.
author: SectionIQ
